A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Veggies**:

**Ingredients:** 2 chicken breasts, 1 lb baby potatoes (halved), 1 broccoli crown (florets), 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 garlic cloves (minced), juice of 1 lemon, 1 tsp oregano, salt/pepper.

**Steps:**  
1. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).  
2. Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt, pepper; spread on sheet pan. Roast 15 min.  
3. Meanwhile, mix remaining oil, garlic, lemon juice, oregano, salt/pepper.  
4. Push potatoes aside, add chicken and broccoli. Pour marinade over all.  
5. Roast 18–20 min until chicken hits 165°F. Rest 5 min, serve.

**Time:** ~35 min total, 10 min active. Easy cleanup, balanced protein/veg/carb.
